page_title: FRE 2-3 BAY | Freiburg v Bayern Munich 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+11' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90+11' The attendance for today's match is 34700.
90+10' The referee Daniel Siebert awards Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) a yellow card.
90+9' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) is booked for saying more than Daniel Siebert was willing to tolerate.

90+9' 2 - 3 A superb goal from great team play! Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90+7' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

90+2' 2 - 2 Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) scores one of the best goals in his career. His rocket of a shot from distance goes straight into the bottom right corner. They will be showing this on every football show for some time to come.
90+2' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Yuito Suzuki makes way for Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
89' Lucas Holer is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg).
87' The game has come to an end for Min-Jae Kim. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
85' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
84' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Noah Atubolu stops the ball from going inside right post.
84' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

81' 2 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich). He perfectly collected a pass from Lennart Karl and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
81' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

81' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
81' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
78' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Johan Manzambi and he is replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
78' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste walks off the pitch and Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
77' The resulting corner, taken by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.

77' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Noah Atubolu makes a brilliant save!
73' The foul by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.

71' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Jan-Niklas Beste delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is lurking. His bullet of a shot from close range goes low into the middle of the goal and it's 2:0.
70' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) prepares to take a corner kick.
70' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' The substitution has been made. Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) has replaced Serge Gnabry.
65' Here is a change. Christian Gunter is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
57' What a huge chance for Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Leon Goretzka can be given a rest.
56' Substitution. Jonathan Tah did his best and is replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
56' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro will be replaced by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
54' Golden chance! Lucas Holer (Freiburg) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
52' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.

46' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Manuel Neuer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45+3' The referee awards a corner and Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes over to take it.
45+2' A cross from Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Freiburg.
45+1' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
43' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Noah Atubolu.
41' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
37' The resulting corner from Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) comes to nothing.
34' Flag goes up against Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
33' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
29' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
28' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Freiburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom left corner, but Manuel Neuer denies him.
26' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.
25' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) for a tough tackle.
25' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is adjudged offside.

20' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
20' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich win a free kick.
19' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg will take a free kick.
17' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
15' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
12' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass outside the penalty area and strikes the ball goalwards. His attempt only finds one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
10' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) swings it in and Serge Gnabry gets on the end of it, but Noah Atubolu shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

8' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Siebert with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.

5' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.

The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
